## Clover Store E3.UI64 for Windows x64
Clover Store Experience 3 brings a personalised app feed, a bottom navigation dock, and an Installed apps view to Windows. Browse the catalogue, manage downloads, use WinGet, Scoop, or Chocolatey, and try supported installers in Windows Sandbox.

A bottom navigation dock connects Discover, Library, Installed, Updates, and Downloads. During fullscreen setup, choose your favourite categories and publishers to personalise your Discover feed.

Link installed apps to their Store listings, pin versions, or skip updates. Manage packages through WinGet, Scoop, or Chocolatey, keep an eye on transfers with the floating download widget, and export selected downloads as an offline ZIP. For supported installers, you can try them in Windows Sandbox or request a system restore point before installing on your PC.
